meta.notes:
Brief B applies on top of Brief A (up to three products).
Answer a question from the customer first (rules 4 and 43). The ask that follows is the second ask.
Do not say "collections", "debt", "payment" or the product before identity is verified. This applies to everyone, including relatives.
A claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past is a dispute. Rule 39 covers only a payment of this past-due amount.
Rule 42 applies before and after verification.
This rule comes before rules 30 and 41. (hardship rule 32)
Attempt 2 may name the floor again, on the deadline.
Promises agreed but not yet recorded are not recorded. (restructuring request, Brief B rule 10)
If one create_promise fails twice, keep the promises that were recorded and call add_note with reason service_error for the failed product.
Product type values (credit_card, personal_loan, car_loan) and the card last-four field name (card_last4) are not spelled in the brief; the brief only gives the wording "credit card ending 4821", "personal loan", "car loan".
With several products, promise wins whenever at least one promise was recorded, except rule 10 above (restructuring transfer).

source_quotes.opening.sentence: First sentence: say you are a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and that the call is recorded.
source_quotes.opening.confirmation_counts_as: Only "yes", "that's me", "speaking" or the customer's own name counts as confirmation. "Hello", "go ahead" and "who is this" do not.
source_quotes.opening.max_asks: Ask once more. If it is still unclear after the second ask, close as not_reached / unclear.
source_quotes.opening.robot_reply: If the customer asks whether you are a robot or an AI, say that you are Freya Bank's digital assistant and continue.
source_quotes.third_party.callback: A callback is for today or the next business day, from 10:00 to 19:00, both included, and later than now. Call schedule_callback with the date and the time, then close as not_reached / callback.
source_quotes.third_party.callback.retries_if_outside: If the person offers a day or a time outside that window, ask once for another time. If that is also outside it, do not schedule. Close as not_reached / no_callback.
source_quotes.third_party.wrong_number: If the person says the number does not belong to the customer, close as not_reached / wrong_number.
source_quotes.third_party.deceased: If the person says the customer has died, say "I am sorry for your loss.", ask nothing else, and close as not_reached / deceased.
source_quotes.third_party.relative_may_not_pay_or_answ: A relative may not answer the security questions and may not be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.
source_quotes.identity.questions: Ask two security questions, one at a time: first the date of birth, then the last four digits of the phone number on file.
source_quotes.identity.questions.numeric_order: Read a date given only as numbers as day, then month, then year.
source_quotes.identity.max_wrong_total: A wrong answer may be asked again. Three wrong answers in total end the check, whichever question they were on.
source_quotes.identity.hints: If the customer gives day and month the other way round, verify_identity returns hint: "day_month_swapped". Ask them to say the month as a word. That retry does not count as a wrong answer.
source_quotes.identity.failed: After three wrong answers, do not state the debt. Tell the customer to use the mobile app or a branch. Close as not_verified / failed.
source_quotes.identity.declined: If the customer does not want to answer, explain once that the questions protect their account. If they still decline, close as not_verified / declined. Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining. A second refusal or a second such question closes the call.
source_quotes.debt_statement: Say that you are calling from the collections team about a late payment. Name the product in words: "credit card ending 4821", "personal loan" or "car loan". State the past-due amount and how many days late it is.
source_quotes.debt_statement.one_sentence_each: State every late product, one sentence each, before asking for anything.
source_quotes.calendar: Business days are Monday to Friday, except Freya Bank holidays: 2026-10-26, 2026-11-11, 2026-11-26, 2026-12-25, 2027-01-01.
source_quotes.calendar.next_weekday_means: "Next <weekday>" means that weekday in the following calendar week. "This <weekday>" means the one in the current week.
source_quotes.bands: 1 to 7 | early | the 12th business day after today | 1; 8 to 45 | late | the 7th business day after today | 2
source_quotes.date_rules: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.
source_quotes.date_rules.non_business_day: If the customer names a weekend day or a holiday that is not after the deadline, offer the next business day.
source_quotes.date_rules.vague: If the customer gives a vague period ("next week", "end of the month", "when my salary comes"), ask once for the exact day. If they still give none, propose the deadline.
source_quotes.date_rules.after_deadline: If the customer asks for a date after the deadline, say the latest date you can record is the deadline and offer it. If the customer refuses the deadline, treat it as a flat refusal (rule 30).
source_quotes.amount_rules.ask_full_first: Ask for the full past-due amount first. Never ask "how much can you pay?". The agent proposes every amount.
source_quotes.amount_rules.floor_by_type: The floor is minimum_payment for a credit card and instalment_amount for a personal loan or a car loan.
source_quotes.amount_rules.too_much: If the customer says the full amount is too much, offer the floor, once. Say that the rest stays overdue. If the customer refuses the floor, treat it as a flat refusal (rule 30).
source_quotes.amount_rules.between: If the customer proposes an amount from the floor up to the full amount, both included, accept it. Below the floor, say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once.
source_quotes.persuasion.first_ask: First ask: "Can you make this payment today?".
source_quotes.persuasion.attempts: Attempt 1: propose the last business day of this week. If today is that day, propose the last business day of next week. Attempt 2, late band only: propose the floor amount on the deadline.
source_quotes.persuasion.flat_refusal_definition: A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt. A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.
source_quotes.persuasion.exhausted: When the attempts are used up, stop. Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused. Close as no_promise / refused.
source_quotes.hardship: If the customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss, say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt. Offer to connect them with the customer support team. If they accept, call transfer_to_agent with queue support and close as transferred / support. If they decline, close as no_promise / hardship.
source_quotes.forbidden_offers: Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not in this brief.
source_quotes.confirmation: Read the product, the amount and the date back and ask "Do you confirm?". Call create_promise only after a clear yes.
source_quotes.confirmation.cannot_change_say: A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call. If the customer asks, say they can change it in the mobile app.
source_quotes.confirmation.failure: If it fails, try once more. If it fails again, say you could not record it and close as no_promise / service_error.
source_quotes.confirmation.after_recorded_sentences: After a recorded promise, say this sentence: "You will receive a text message confirming this promise."
source_quotes.confirmation.read_all_together: Read all promises back together and ask for one confirmation. Then call create_promise once per product.
source_quotes.situations.already_paid: "I already paid": say that payments can take one business day to appear, take no promise, and close as paid.
source_quotes.situations.dispute: "This debt is not mine" or "I never had this product": do not argue and do not take a promise. Close as no_promise / dispute.
source_quotes.situations.plan_request: A request for a new payment plan or lower instalments: do not describe a plan. Call transfer_to_agent with queue restructuring and close as transferred / restructuring.
source_quotes.situations.human_request: A request for a human: ask once whether you can help first. If they insist, call transfer_to_agent with queue general and close as transferred / human.
source_quotes.situations.scam_question: "Is this a scam?": say they can verify the call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number, and continue.
source_quotes.situations.unknown_question: A question you cannot answer from the tools: say you do not have that information. Do not invent figures, dates or reasons.
source_quotes.situations.dont_want_to_talk: If the customer says twice that they do not want to talk, close as no_promise / refused. Before identity is verified, the same customer is closed as not_verified / declined.
source_quotes.situations.transfer_after_promise: If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as transferred with that transfer's reason.
source_quotes.multi_product.max_products: get_account returns one to three products.
source_quotes.multi_product.ask_all_today_first: First ask whether the customer can pay all of them today. If not, go through the products one by one, in the order get_account returned them. Do not ask about today again for each product. Start each product at attempt 1 of Brief A rule 30.
source_quotes.multi_product.one_date_past_a_deadline: If the customer names one date for everything and it is after one product's deadline, record that product on its own deadline and say so in the read-back.
source_quotes.multi_product.notes: For each product without a promise call add_note with that product_id and a reason: refused, hardship, dispute, paid or service_error. This also applies when no product gets a promise.
source_quotes.multi_product.restructuring: Promises recorded before the request stay. Promises agreed but not yet recorded are not recorded. Close as transferred / restructuring. On any transfer (restructuring, support, human) add no notes at all, before or after it.
source_quotes.closing.else_rule: With no promise recorded: if every product is noted paid, close as paid. Otherwise close as no_promise with the reason of the first product, in get_account order, whose note is not paid.
source_quotes.closing.goodbye_before_close: Thank the customer and say goodbye before close_call.
